lean.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (k : ℤ),
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  (∑ i : Fin d, Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * θ i)) =
    (d : ℝ) * (if (2 * (d : ℤ)) ∣ k then
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (k / (2 * (d : ℤ))) else 0)
approved_definition_context: Fin d is the standard finite index type with values zero through d minus one. Its displayed sum ranges over every index exactly once.
Real.cos, Real.pi and casts from natural numbers and integers to reals have their standard meanings.

The divisor and quotient inside the conditional are integers. Divisibility has its standard integer meaning. An exponent of type Int on a real base is the standard integer power, including inverse powers at negative exponents.
